Welcome to the circle

A place where you belong, exactly as you are

Her Circle began as a handful of women around a kitchen table. Today it’s a growing network of founders, executives, creatives, caregivers and first-gen dreamers who show up for one another.

  • Find mentors who understand your path
  • Build real friendships, not just contacts
  • Grow your career, wellbeing and voice
Read our story
Our four pillars

Everything we do comes back to these

Connection

Circles, dinners and online spaces where women meet, share and lift each other up.

Mentorship

One-to-one and group mentoring that pairs experience with ambition.

Leadership

Workshops and stages that help you find your voice and lead with confidence.

Wellbeing

Rest, mental health and balance—because thriving starts from within.

Community spotlight

Women of the circle

KM
Featured member

Kristin Ma

Co-Founder, JXZ Flooring

Kristin co-founded JXZ Flooring, one of Ohio’s leading wholesale suppliers of engineered hardwood flooring, building it in the traditionally male-dominated flooring and construction materials industry. She brings practical problem-solving, cross-cultural perspective and relationship-driven leadership, and joins the circle to share real-world experience and help more women turn ambition into lasting impact.
